analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price (93,890 KRW) vs SMA5/20/50 (105,744/108,762/104,275 KRW): below short/mid-term trends, indicating weakness.
· Position vs SMA100/200 (138,966/110,964 KRW): below long-term trends, maintaining bearish strength.
· 52-week position (28.0%) + current price level near historical lows.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (53.2 → 37.0): failed oversold escape, indicating continued weakness.
· MACD histogram trajectory (760.0954 → -1295.1066): worsening, signaling bearish expansion.
· Bollinger Band current price position (near lower band 96,613 KRW): approaching lower band, with band width at 22.34% expansion.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support (68,045 KRW): below Pivot S1 (84,543 KRW), weakening support.
· Swing resistance (95,500 KRW): below current price, forming resistance at the lower end of the range.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern: 5-day low 92,965 KRW, 20-day low 92,965 KRW, confirming sideways pattern.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (1.35x): movement gaining momentum, suggesting potential short-term bounce.
· Current phase diagnosis: accumulation phase, buy entry contingent on RSI oversold escape and ADX trend formation confirmation.
